name: review-inbox
description: Your GitHub work in a drawer: PRs waiting for your review, each summarized in plain language, your open PRs with their reviews, and your issues

scope.title: Search scope
scope.description: GitHub search qualifiers that narrow every tab, e.g. org:my-org or repo:owner/name; empty watches every repository

githubUser.title: GitHub account
githubUser.description: gh account to use when several are logged in; empty uses the active one

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, drawer, toasts and summaries; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English
